reason: Status remains partial-comparison. Agent-browser has repeated CLI coverage for verified actions, scoped output, forms, caller-orchestrated recovery, background-tab actions, and named-session isolation (10/10). Playwright MCP has repeated MCP coverage for verified action, scoped observation, forms, open shadow root, same-origin iframe, and caller-orchestrated recovery; its headless hidden-to-visible condition remains unsupported by the pinned environment. Scout local regressions are recorded separately: v20 passed 32/32 scenarios with zero false successes, including process-local same-name session isolation. That Scout result is not a matched competitor row because Scout uses the active session per MCP process and agent-browser accepts a per-call session override. A pinned agent-browser 0.41.2 MCP two-server probe reproduced open issue #2422 once; proposed PR #2430 was open when checked. Keep this narrow issue reproduction distinct from repeated rates and continue broader adversarial cases.
rules: Run each tool against the same local fixture server and scenario.
Pin tool and browser versions; never use an unpinned latest build in a published result.
Use each product's documented interface and disclose any adapter code.
Apply the same externally observable success predicate; distinguish native postcondition support from caller-side verification.
Save raw output and report exact output byte counting rules.
Repeat timing scenarios at least 10 times; report median and p95 separately from completion and false-success rates.
Mark unsupported scenarios unsupported rather than assigning a failure or success.

field_contract.scenario: One report row or nested scenario object represents one comparable scenario; disclose whether counts and bytes are per repetition or aggregated.
field_contract.duration: Report median and p95 for timing claims, plus samples where practical; state what startup, cleanup, and metadata work is included.
field_contract.verification: State the externally observable condition and report subpredicates when the overall scenario is incomplete.
field_contract.false_success: Count only cases where the tool reports success while the external predicate is false; a UI signal that is explicitly treated as ambiguous evidence is not itself a tool false success.
field_contract.calls: Use the aliases above and state whether values are per repetition or aggregate totals.
field_contract.raw_evidence: Use the aliases above for captured output/transcripts and structured per-repetition evidence; preserve exact byte-counting boundaries.
field_contract.recovery: For uncertain-mutation scenarios, report native_recovery_record and recovery_method. Separate built-in target-bound reconciliation from adapter-authored process interruption, client deadlines, polling, and inspection; do not equate final-state parity with equivalent recovery support.
